name: Zoram'gar Outpost
summary: Horde forces hold the western shore of Ashenvale at Zoram'gar Outpost. From this fortified beachhead, they watch the Zoram Strand and the dangers beyond it.

sections.title: A Bastion on the Strand
sections.body: Zoram'gar Outpost holds Ashenvale's northwestern edge, where forest meets sea. Night elf territory lies inland, and hazards wait offshore. Scouts, hunters, and shaman keep watch from the isolated camp. Naga prowl the shallows, while cultists and primal horrors stir in Blackfathom Deeps, the cavern system down the shore.

sections.title: Strategic Importance
sections.body: Zoram'gar Outpost links by flight to other Horde holdings: Splintertree Post, the Crossroads, and Thunder Bluff. Though small, the camp anchors Horde supply lines along Ashenvale's western coast.

faq.q: Why did the Horde establish Zoram'gar Outpost?
aliases: why did horde build zoram gar
faq.answer: The Horde established Zoram'gar Outpost to secure a foothold on Ashenvale's western shore. From the camp, they watch the Zoram Strand and hold a defensible position against the aggressive naga along the coast.

faq.q: What threats does the outpost face?
faq.answer: Wrathtail naga slither across the Zoram Strand and threaten the outpost. Twilight cultists and beastly horrors in the nearby temple ruins of Blackfathom Deeps bring constant danger as well.

faq.q: Where does the outpost connect via flight master?
aliases: where can i fly from zoram gar
faq.answer: Wind riders carry travelers by air from Zoram'gar Outpost across central Kalimdor. They link it to Splintertree Post, Sun Rock Retreat, the Crossroads, and Thunder Bluff, the tauren capital.

faq.q: What is the relation between the outpost and Blackfathom Deeps?
faq.answer: Blackfathom Deeps lies just north of Zoram'gar Outpost among shoreline ruins. Horde forces at the outpost watch corruption seep from the flooded temple and send adventurers inside to oppose the cultists and their beast, Aku'mai.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you can find your main haven in northwest Ashenvale at Zoram'gar Outpost. There, you have shelter, rest, and wind rider transport amid dangerous wilderness.
As an Alliance member, you face an entrenched Horde presence on Ashenvale's coast. Zoram'gar Outpost holds a dangerous supply foothold near night elf ancestral lands.
